text:
```yaml
name: Close Inactive Issues

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *' # Runs daily at midnight UTC

jobs:
  close-inactive-issues:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run stale action
        uses: actions/stale@v10
        with:
          days-before-stale: 700
          days-before-close: 30
          exempt-issue-labels: 'data-issue'
          exempt-pr-labels: ''
          stale-issue-message: 'This issue has been automatically marked as stale because it has not had recent activity. It will be closed if no further activity occurs within 30 days.'
          close-issue-message: 'This issue was closed because it has not had recent activity for over 2 years.'
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
